Backtracking. For each step, swap current with each later position; recurse.

def permute(nums):
    out = []
    def backtrack(start):
        if start == len(nums):
            out.append(nums[:])
            return
        for i in range(start, len(nums)):
            nums[start], nums[i] = nums[i], nums[start]
            backtrack(start + 1)
            nums[start], nums[i] = nums[i], nums[start]
    backtrack(0)
    return out
```
